ns2:course.label: Diversity in Music Classrooms
ns2:course.description: Strategies for adapting and modifying music instruction for students with disabilities will be emphasized, along with educatoinal practices that address gender, race, sexual orientation, and cultural diversity in general, choral, and instrumental music classes. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: MUS 342.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: MUS 342.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Music Education or Music major(s).
